title: BSNL Greets the Nation on the 80th Independence Day; Announces New Customer-Centric Digital Initiatives
body_text:
On the joyous occasion of the 80th Independence Day of India, Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL) extends its warm greetings and best wishes to its valued customers, all citizens of Bharat, business partners, associates and employees.
As India’s trusted public sector telecommunications service provider, BSNL remains steadfast in its commitment to providing reliable, secure, affordable and inclusive digital connectivity across the nation ensuring reliable communication services even under challenging geographical and climatic conditions. Guided by the vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat and Digital India, BSNL is committed to building a resilient and future-ready telecommunications network powered by indigenous technologies and customer-centric innovations. Its dedicated workforce continues to serve the nation with unwavering commitment,  ensuring the benefits of Digital India reach every citizen of Bharat.
As part of its Independence Day celebrations, BSNL is pleased to announce a series of new customer-centric initiatives and special offerings aimed at enhancing customer experience, expanding digital services and making advanced connectivity and entertainment more accessible to citizens across the country.
Strengthening the Network — Nationwide 4G Expansion & Enhanced Customer Experience
Reinforcing its commitment to world-class, indigenous connectivity, BSNL has significantly strengthened its mobile network. The Company has ordered over 26,300 additional 4G BTS (Base Transceiver Station) sites for deployment across the country, further widening its 4G footprint into more towns, villages and remote areas. Alongside this expansion, BSNL’s 4G network has been comprehensively optimised — delivering improved network quality, wider and more consistent coverage, faster data speeds and better call performance, and a markedly enhanced overall customer experience — on a fully indigenous, 5G-upgradable technology stack.
Independence Day Special Announcements
1. Re. 1 Freedom 2.0 Offer
As a special Independence Day initiative, BSNL introduces the Re. 1 Freedom 2.0 Offer, enabling new customers to experience the BSNL mobile network for just Re. 1.
Under the offer, customers get:
1 GB data per day 100 SMS per day Unlimited voice calls 24 days validity
The offer is designed to make it easier and more affordable for customers to experience BSNL’s mobile services and join India’s trusted telecom network.
2. BSNL Fibre Freedom Plan – Launch Offer at ₹1,111 per Month
BSNL introduces the Fibre Freedom Plan, offering a premium broadband and entertainment experience at a special launch price of ₹1,111 per month.The plan offers:
Internet speeds up to 200 Mbps 5,000 GB monthly data Access to 25+ premium OTT platforms A comprehensive broadband and digital entertainment experience through a single connection
The initiative further strengthens BSNL’s commitment to delivering high-speed, affordable and value-driven broadband services to customers.
3. Launch of New Selfcare Mobile App for Customers
BSNL has revamped its Selfcare Mobile App, “BSNL Selfcare New,” on Android and iOS platforms, offering customers a convenient, user-friendly digital experience. The app enables services such as prepaid recharge, postpaid and landline bill payments, complaint registration and tracking, DND management, payment history, Fibre booking requests, AI chatbot support, voice search, multiple account management, and access to BSNL Entertainment TV, all through a single platform.
4. BSNL Free Entertainment TV (Powered by Tango TV)
BSNL mobile subscribers can now enjoy around 500 Live TV channels –‘BSNL Free Entertainment TV’, powered by Tango TV, free of cost for all our beloved customers, through its new BSNL Selfcare App.
The service provides access to a wide range of live television channels and on-demand entertainment content, enabling BSNL customers to enjoy digital entertainment conveniently through their mobile devices.
5. BSNL Satellite Phone Services
BSNL provides Global Satellite Phone Service (GSPS) using satellite connectivity, enabling voice communication in locations where conventional terrestrial mobile networks may not be available.
The service is particularly relevant for remote, geographically challenging and communication-sensitive locations, further reinforcing BSNL’s role in ensuring connectivity across diverse terrains and regions of the country.
6 . Additional validity on Plan ₹2399
As part of its Independence Day celebrations, BSNL is offering an additional 47 days of validity in its yearly plan (365+47=412 Days ) on ₹2,399 annual prepaid plan, further enhancing the value for customers for a limited period.
Under the offer, customers will enjoy extended service validity along with the existing benefits of the ₹2,399 plan, making it an attractive proposition for BSNL subscribers.
7 . BSNL–Polycab Partnership — Make in India Telecom Manufacturing
BSNL has partnered with Polycab to advance indigenous telecom manufacturing under the Make in India and Atmanirbhar Bharat vision. At the heart of the collaboration is Polycab's Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) — a state-of-the-art assembly and manufacturing facility for telecom and networking equipment [cameras/ONTs/Routers etc] — producing reliable, made-in-India hardware.
Delivered through an innovative Hardware-as-a-Service (HaaS) model, the partnership enables BSNL to assist in roll out scalable, cost-effective and future-ready infrastructure without heavy upfront investment both for BSNL and others— while strengthening domestic manufacturing and self-reliance in India's telecom sector.
These initiatives reaffirm BSNL’s unwavering commitment to delivering affordable, secure, reliable and innovative digital solutions while contributing to the vision of a Digitally Empowered India.
As the nation celebrates the 80th Independence Day and commemorates its remarkable journey of freedom, development and progress, BSNL remains dedicated to connecting people, empowering communities and enabling inclusive growth through reliable and innovative telecommunications services.
On this proud occasion, BSNL reiterates its commitment to serving the nation with excellence, strengthening digital connectivity and contributing to India’s digital future.
BSNL wishes all citizens a very Happy 80th Independence Day.
Jai Hind! Jai Bharat!
***
NJ/AR

enrichment.summary: On the occasion of India's 80th Independence Day, BSNL announced a bundle of customer-facing initiatives including a Re. 1 trial mobile offer, a ₹1,111/month Fibre Freedom broadband plan with 200 Mbps speed and OTT access, a revamped Selfcare app, free 'BSNL Entertainment TV' with ~500 channels, satellite phone services, extra validity on its ₹2,399 annual plan, and a partnership with Polycab for domestic manufacturing of telecom hardware. It also stated it has ordered over 26,300 additional 4G BTS sites to expand its indigenous, 5G-upgradable 4G network into more towns and villages.
enrichment.context:
BSNL, India's state-owned telecom operator, has been rolling out an indigenously developed 4G network (built with technology from C-DOT, TCS and other domestic vendors) as a flagship example of Atmanirbhar Bharat in telecommunications, reducing dependence on foreign equipment makers like Nokia and Ericsson. This indigenous stack, first commercially deployed in 2023-24, has faced criticism over pace and quality of rollout, so continued network expansion and optimisation announcements are part of an ongoing effort to demonstrate progress and win back subscribers lost to private telcos like Jio and Airtel.

The release is largely a promotional and customer-outreach communication timed to Independence Day, bundling tariff offers, app upgrades, and entertainment tie-ups (Tango TV) that are standard competitive responses in India's telecom market. The BSNL-Polycab Hardware-as-a-Service partnership for manufacturing telecom equipment (ONTs, routers, cameras) is a minor extension of the Make in India push in electronics manufacturing, but does not represent a new policy or scheme in itself.
